bullets.text: AirPods Pro 3 Translation Magic - **Apple**'s latest AirPods feature real-time translation powered by **Apple Intelligence**.
AI Job Interview Prep - **Coursera** introduces AI personas to enhance job interview practice for students.
Apple Watch Health Upgrades - New **Apple Watch** models will support features like Sleep Score and hypertension alerts.
iPhone Air's Slim Design - The new **iPhone Air** is Apple's thinnest model yet, emphasizing style and portability.
SpaceX's $17B Spectrum Deal - **SpaceX** aims to dominate the satellite-to-phone market with a major spectrum acquisition.
AI Training Startup Soars - **Mercor** targets a $10B valuation as it connects AI firms with domain experts.
iPhone 17 Pro's Creator Focus - The **iPhone 17 Pro** aims to replace traditional cameras for content creators with advanced features.
Apple's Enhanced Security - The **iPhone 17** introduces Memory Integrity Enforcement to combat spyware threats.
